Self.Wiki: Map place name override (formerly Map Name Override; the game's CSMapPlaceNameOverrideRegionMan). While the player is inside it, its Location Text ID replaces the one from the collision the player stands on, so the area gets its own place-name title card. No retail Nightreign map uses it.

LocationTextID.Wiki: Place-name text used instead of the collision's Location Text ID, with the same sign convention: negative values show the title card when entering, positive values on map load.
